name: Prof. Gordon Slater
short: Professor Gordon Slater is an orthopaedic surgeon with more than three decades of clinical experience. A Fellow of the Royal Australasian College of Surgeons and Professor at the University of Technology Sydney, he specialises in foot and ankle surgery and regenerative medicine.
long: Professor Gordon Slater is an orthopaedic surgeon specialising in foot and ankle surgery, with a career spanning more than three decades of clinical practice and research. He has been a Fellow of the Royal Australasian College of Surgeons in orthopaedics since 1997 and holds a professorial appointment at the University of Technology Sydney. He has published more than fifty peer-reviewed research papers, holds multiple patents for medical devices, and is the founder of Integrant Pty Ltd. In Chaos to Creation he examines what regenerative science may mean for the future of human health and longevity.
